name: Disability Rights Advocacy Center (DRAC)
description: Operates the national disability helpline (toll-free + WhatsApp); legal aid and rights advocacy.

name: Joint National Association of Persons with Disabilities (JONAPWD)
description: Umbrella body of disability clusters across Nigeria; policy advocacy and member referrals.

name: Centre for Citizens with Disabilities (CCD)
description: Research, civic participation and inclusive-governance programmes for PWDs.

name: TAF Africa (The Albino Foundation)
description: Albinism support, disability-inclusive democracy, publishes accessible civic materials.

name: Nigerian Association of the Blind (NAB)
description: Membership association for blind persons; rehabilitation referrals and advocacy.

name: Nigerian National Association of the Deaf (NNAD)
description: Deaf community association; sign-language promotion and member support.

name: Irede Foundation
description: Free prosthetic limbs for children; mobility and inclusion support.

name: Down Syndrome Foundation Nigeria
description: Early intervention, schooling support and family resources for Down syndrome.

name: Spinal Cord Injuries Association of Nigeria (SCIAN)
description: Peer support, rehabilitation referrals and advocacy for spinal cord injury survivors.

name: Mentally Aware Nigeria Initiative (MANI)
description: Mental-health helpline, counselling referrals and anti-stigma programmes.
